measures.title: Authorizing the City's Salary Commission to Set the Mayor's Salary
measures.what_it_does: Charter amendment: removes the rule that the mayor's salary is never less than the highest-paid city official or employee, and has the city's independent salary commission set it.
measures.cost_line: No tax or fee; changes how the mayor's salary is set.

measures.title: Streamlining the City's Contract Review Process to Allow Electronic Signatures
measures.what_it_does: Charter amendment: lets the mayor's designee sign city contracts, allows electronic signatures, and drops the finance director's attestation and seal.
measures.cost_line: No tax or fee; changes how city contracts are signed.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.title: Prohibition of Algorithmic Price-Fixing in the Rental Market
measures.what_it_does: Citizen initiative: bans landlord rent-setting agreements and paid algorithmic services that recommend rents or terms to multiple landlords, with a private right of action, tenant and employee anti-retaliation protections, and civil and criminal penalties.
measures.cost_line: No tax or fee; enforcement by the City Attorney and private lawsuits.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.title: Levy Lid Lift for Public Safety and Essential Community Services
measures.what_it_does: Lifts Lynden's regular property tax levy for police, fire, streets, parks, the Community/Senior Center, restored staff positions and Friday City Hall hours, with 3% annual increases for 2027-2035.
measures.cost_line: Up to $1.54304 per $1,000 of assessed value for 2027 collection, $0.50 per $1,000 more than the 2025 levy rate.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: Whatcom County Fire Protection District No. 1
measures.title: Regular Property Tax Levy Lid Lift
measures.what_it_does: Resets the fire district's regular levy for fire and EMS (Everson/Nooksack area) with a 106% limit factor for the following nine years.
measures.cost_line: Up to $1.48 per $1,000 of assessed value for 2027 collection; the district says its current rate is $1.12.
